dossier.psychProfile: Arrogant, passive-aggressive, and pathologically competitive. Bates disguises his ruthlessness with a 'folksy' billionaire persona. Obsessed with market share and closed ecosystems. Secretly misses the 'glory days' of 20th-century gaming.
dossier.attackVectors: Responds well to 'visionary' flattery that compares him to 21st-century tech giants. Highly susceptible to urgent 'zero-day' exploit reports in the Helix OS kernel. Can be bribed with vintage, physical Xbox hardware.
leakedMemos: Bates to Dev Team: 'If it doesn't phone home every 4 minutes, it's not a feature; it's a security flaw. Fix it.'
Internal HR: 'The term 'Planned Obsolescence' is now replaced with 'Mandatory Evolution Cycle'. Update all documentation.'

rivalShade.intel: Panopticon watches. We run. We've hardcoded a backdoor into the Helix kernel that redirects 1% of Panopticon's telemetry back to us. They don't even know.

quickhackVault.name: Helix OS Brick
quickhackVault.description: Forces a critical kernel panic on enemy systems. Complete shutdown. Flavor: 'Your data, our dominion.'

blackmail: Records of Bates using 'Dominion Cloud' data to manipulate the real estate market in the orbital colonies.
Evidence that HoloWindows 2077 Update 47 intentionally bricked rival smart-hab systems.
